## Code Example: Exploring Data with R & Tidyverse

Here is an example code chunk demonstrating how to create a data visualization using `ggplot2` in R:

```{r}
#| label: first-plot
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

# Sample dataset: replace with your own data or course dataset
sample_data <- tibble(
  x = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
  y = c(2, 4, 7, 9, 12),
  category = c("A", "A", "B", "B", "B")
)

# Create a plot using ggplot2
ggplot(sample_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = category)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "My First ggplot Visualization",
    subtitle = "Created with R & the tidyverse",
    x = "Independent Variable (X)",
    y = "Dependent Variable (Y)",
    color = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
